explication: UAD-ng is a desktop Android debloating application with both GUI and CLI interfaces. Users inspect connected devices and their packages, consult the community debloat list, filter or review package recommendations, then change package state through ADB; the GUI also exposes configuration and device backup/restore. The graph preserves the documented update and list-fetch capabilities, plus the GUI’s distinct views and major widgets. Some subsystem wiring is unsampled, so unverified relationships are omitted.
